name: GitLab CI/CD
subtitle: CI/CD in the GitLab DevSecOps platform
creator: GitLab (started 2011 by Dmitriy Zaporozhets and Valery Sizov)
license: Open core (MIT Community Edition, commercial tiers)
description: Pipelines defined in .gitlab-ci.yml run on GitLab Runners, integrated with merge requests, the container registry, security scanning and environments. The whole platform can be self-hosted.

concepts.explanation: Everything that runs for a commit.

codeSamples.label: YAML · .gitlab-ci.yml
codeSamples.code:
stages: [test, deploy]

test:
  stage: test
  image: node:24
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm test

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  script: ./deploy.sh
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"

pros: Built-in security scanning on higher tiers
cons: Best features sit in expensive tiers

pricing.summary: Free: 400 compute min/mo and up to 5 users. Premium: $29/user/mo billed annually, with 10,000 compute min. Ultimate: custom.
